quote: Martin did a great job conducting an interactive soft skills training, focussed on communication, through phone conferencing with several offices located worldwide. Despite the technical challenges, Martin set a framework where stories and professional experience could be shared and learnt. We gained helpful tips and tools for networking and communication with clients. In addition, Martin spotted the challenges of our industry during the preparation discussions very quickly, and delivered a tailor made communication course, thus fostering our professional development and added value to our day-to-day work.
author: Svenja Bernhardt and Hadewich van Alst - The Corpag Group
subject: Networking
